messages:
maria: Quick async — we need a short ownership handoff + blockers list for the v2 cutover on /v2/predict and /v2/chat. Planning to open the traffic toggle on Mon 09:00 PT. Who's owning each endpoint and which PRs need an urgent review? cc @kevin @anya
kevin: I can own /v2/predict (runtime side). Current blockers: 1) PR #4578 needs a perf test + a small lint fix, 2) infra quota for new GPU pool hasn't been granted (cloud ticket 78912).
anya: I'll take /v2/chat (api + schema). My PR is #4621 (schema rename + response shape). Waiting on SDK bump — SDK team flagged a breaking change in the Python client.
sam: SDK team here — the Python SDK bump is on our side, target is v0.9.3. PR #2105 is the bump + changelog but tests are failing on Windows CI (flaky test in auth). We're triaging, ETA EOD today.
maria: Good. If SDK is delayed, we need a rollback plan for chat. Can we keep /v2/chat behind the feature flag until SDK is live?
kevin: Yes — runtime will honor the flag. We'll route traffic to /v1/chat for flagged users. Need the exact flag key from product.
anya: Product gave flag key: "v2_chat_rollout". Can someone paste the curl to toggle?
kevin: curl -X POST "https://console.internal/features/v2_chat_rollout/toggle" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"enabled":true,"traffic_percent":10}'
anya: thanks. I'll coordinate the percent slices. First slice 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 4 hours if no errors.
sam: FYI the SDK PR depends on a small serializer change in #4621 (anya's). If you merge schema first, I can re-run tests and ship quickly.
anya: noted — I'll try to split the schema change into a non-breaking follow-up and merge the surface-level rename today.
maria: Action items so far: kevin merges #4578 after perf + lint; anya splits & merges schema; sam fixes SDK CI flakes and lands #2105. If any of these slip, hold feature flag.
kevin: Also: canary window scheduled Mon 09:00-11:00 PT on shard-a. Please don't schedule other deploys then. deploy-bot: Canary job started for shard-a at 2024-11-18T09:00:01Z.
san: (typo) -> sam: ^^ I mean deploy-bot message is from CI. It shows smoke tests running.
maria: Quick ask about logs/metrics: can we add a temporary metric for v2 error-rate by endpoint? I want granular dashboards during the ramp.
kevin: Adding metric now: metric name `api.v2.error_rate.endpoint`. Will be available in console in ~15m.
anya: Also adding a small smoke prompt set for chat to detect truncation/regression. Pushing to canary regression harness.
sam: Update: I fixed the flaky auth test, re-running CI. If green, I'll request a senior review from @maria for the SDK bump.
maria: I'll review once tests pass. If anything looks risky we gate on the flag.
kevin: One more dependency: traffic manager needs a rule to fallback to /v1/predict when the new predictor responds with 503. I've filed infra PR #889 to add the fallback. Please review.
anya: Reviewing #889 now. Small nit in config but LGTM after change.
kevin: Great. Estimated timeline: all PRs merged by today EOD -> toggle small slice Mon 09:00 -> canary + monitor -> full ramp by Mon 13:00 if green.
maria: If anyone hits a blocker, drop updates here. I'll create a short runbook section in the cutover doc for rollback steps. :white_check_mark:
dev-bot: Reminder: please annotate PRs with `release-note` label and link to the rollout doc: https://go/internal/v2-cutover (automated check required).
sam: CI green on #2105, requested review from maria.
maria: Reviewing now. Small comment in serializer test, pushing suggestion.
anya: Merged #4621 (split change). Sam, rebase SDK and I'll do a quick smoke run.
sam: rebased and pushed, CI kicked off.
kevin: Perf test for #4578 passed (p95 token latency improved). Lint fix applied. PR re-requested for review.
maria: Approving #4578.
kevin: Merged #4578.
dev-bot: Canary job completed on shard-a: smoke passed, error_rate: 0.8% (threshold 2%).
maria: Excellent. Sam, once SDK PR is merged I'll flip the 10% slice at 09:00. If error_rate > 2% at any point, we rollback to the flag off and notify infra.
sam: SDK PR merged. :tada: Requested canary-ready label.
maria: Flipping slice now to 10%. curl command executed.
kevin: Observability notes: watch `api.v2.error_rate.endpoint`, `sdk.client.errors`, and p95 latency by model. I'll post a dashboard link in 5m.
anya: Smoke harness ran sample prompts — no truncation detected.
maria: Okay we're live on 10% for chat + predict. Monitoring for 30m, then ramp if stable. Thanks all for quick turnaround.
kevin: Thanks team. I'll follow up with infra ticket closure once fallback rule is in prod.
anya: I'll update the migration owners doc with final owners + PR list.
sam: Closing loop on SDK: publishing v0.9.3 to PyPI in ~10m.
maria: Great. I'll post a short debrief in #eng-postmortems after full ramp.
